Retirees often don't know what to do with their new-found time. Life can become mundane unless the retiree takes action to avoid it.
Men can have more problems than women in retirement, in part because their identity is more closely tied to their careers. While employed, they develop a strong routine that brings self-esteem and a sense of purpose.
These can be maintained after retirement if the retiree is open to new ideas. There are lots of activities beyond lawn bowls and cards to occupy and challenge a person. Whether they be volunteering, exploring new or old environments, or learning new skills, challenges for everyone are out there and easy to access.
This video project shows how people can become involved in various activities across Australia.

Life: get amongst it would like to thank  Peggy Cameron  for her generous support
